failure_summary.description: The agent missed the explicitly requested return flight and cache saves, while repeating a restaurant search already satisfied by cache.
The agent treated a newly stated restaurant rating criterion as a no-op instead of filtering compatible cached results.
The agent inferred a same-city flight route from a hotel destination instead of asking for the unknown departure city.

patch.reasoning: The first two failures are already addressed directly by the skill’s round-trip, cache, and follow-up guidance, so repeating those rules is unlikely to help. One cross-domain gap remains: when flights are added to a trip whose destination is established by its lodging request, the lodging city can identify the flight destination, but not the origin.

edits.target: Ask for an unknown endpoint rather than assuming a route.
edits.content: - If the user adds a flight request to a trip whose destination is clearly established by a lodging request, use the lodging city as the flight destination. Do not infer the departure city from the lodging location; ask for any flight endpoint that remains unknown.
